paragraphs: Chapter 838
Episode 209. The Seventh Tomb of Temer - Kaitam's Painting (11)
In the past life, and again in this life.
The sword Jin chose was Barisada. Of course, he had never touched Barisada even once after the selection ceremony, but Jin felt as if the sword had always been with him.
Although it was a sort of imitation made into a picture, Barisada now was no different from a real object.
And the sword was acknowledging Jin. That he had the qualifications to be its owner, that he could wield it to annihilate the enemy.
'Suddenly, I remember the day I finished my spare rider life.'
Chiron had demonstrated a modification of the Five's Reincarnation on the day Jin returned to the clan to become a knight.
A sword incredibly slow.
But unavoidable.
"Barisada...!"
The imposter bulged his eyes and concentrated the Dark Advent on Jin. The power of death that had been applied to the Ten Knights and Murakan was all directed towards Jin.
But no matter how much the pain increased, it couldn't stop him.
It couldn't disrupt him, nor even cause a minor disturbance. As the imposter hoped for Jin's death through the Dark Advent, Jin hoped to cut him with the sword.
There was no need to reassess whose struggle was deeper and stronger. The death confirmed by the imposter quickly faded, and Jin's sword became more and more clear.
'Why can't I avoid it...!'
The imposter couldn't understand Jin's sword, which was approaching step by step. His body, as if bound by chains, didn't move as he wished.
"Didn't I say it's over, imposter? So, there's no need to try to understand."
Jin was fully aware of his feelings. Only those who had surpassed their limits without anyone's help could face Reincarnation and still ignite their willpower.
It was a story that didn't apply to the imposter. An entity that is merely an illusion in itself cannot stand against Reincarnation.
Jin took a step towards the imposter slowly.

The sword he swung once before reaching him was cutting off the spirit that constituted the Dark Advent. The realm of the Dark Advent was narrowing as if the dark cave wall was crumbling. Barisada, shining brightly, was paving the way."
The white sword energy spread endlessly in a circle, erasing the Dark Advent. That too was slow, but likewise, the imposter couldn't avoid it.
If there was just a little more distance, if the imposter had faced reality and escaped from his ego intoxication of being 'invincible'.

He might have had a chance to hide himself in the Dark Advent again by floundering somehow. After all, the power he possessed was clearly touching creation, even if it wasn't earned through his own struggle.
"You should have run away before this happened."
Jin repeated the imposter's words and swung his sword for the second time.

The downward slash of the sword cut open the imposter's chest. He fiercely protected that spot to guard his heart, but the spirit formed like armor, the scales, bones and flesh all were cut away in vain.
The imposter's heart, flickering in black, appeared. It was already broken and cracked in places.
"No...this can't be. I am Murakan. I have become the Murakan of a thousand years ago. A being that all creation revered! I can't be defeated by the likes of you, who hasn't even reached creation...!"
"When the bottom is exposed, the true colors come out. If it had been that guy instead of you, he would have blocked this much easily. If it was a true creation class."
"Kill me!"
The imposter was staking everything on his last act of defiance.
He started using even the spirit that was sustaining his heart to strengthen the Dark Advent. The dissipated darkness filled again, and Barisada seemed to lose its light for a moment.
The wings that he spread out with a roar constantly spewed out black constraints, and the swirling spirit seemed about to swallow Jin and tear him apart at any moment.
"It's futile."

However, Jin shattered even that with his third sword stroke, a single downward slash. The threatening black constraints were absorbed by Barisada's blade and scattered into bright white particles, and the darkness was cut into a mass larger than when it first spread.
The imposter had to face Barisada approaching his heart without being able to put any distance between them.

"Stop... What good will killing me do you, never! You'll face a filthy and terrible truth. Your guardian dragon will go mad in front of it and become like me! If you stop now, I'll tell you who sent me here."
"You're making it a little tempting, this bastard. But what to do, I promised that guy I'd kill you right away."

"This picture, this world has been distorted by corruption! I'm at the core of it. If you kill me, the whole world might collapse...! If I die, you might be trapped here forever. Anything can happen in a distorted world."
In the end, the imposter was just an imposter.

No matter how much he resembled Murakan, there was an insurmountable gulf between him and the real Murakan from those days. In the first place, the Creator was an entity that could never, ever be replicated. No deity could arbitrarily create an entity with the status of the Creator.
"I'll figure that out. I'll find and kill whoever created you. I'm sick of hearing more, so disappear now."
Whoosh-!
The fourth sword strike, a straightforward and slow thrust, pierced the impostor's heart. As soon as his heart was pierced, the dark landscape of the Dark Arrival was erased all at once.
He fluttered his wings and his whole body trembled.
"[Groan...argh... You...will...regret...this...Jin...Runcandel! You...shouldn't...have...come here.]"
Just as the impostor said.

The destruction of the heart not only affected the Dark Arrival. The collapsing storm fortress, which was now visible again, and even the sky, where the storm had cleared and the moonlight was flowing brightly, were enveloped in unstable vibrations.
Jin did not hesitate and twisted his sword to completely destroy the impostor's heart. Black fragments scattered in all directions, disappearing without a trace.
Now he could not feel the impostor's energy at all. It was a hollow demise, as if to prove that he was nothing more than a fake.
Jin sheathed his sword. He spat out a mouthful of blood, but he did not have any fatal injuries.
'It seems that he was telling the truth about being the core of this world. The whole void feels like it could collapse at any moment.'

He wasn't anxious. Whether he would rip through the void with his spirit sword and escape, or simply endure with brute force while looking for an opportunity, there must have been a way. If that had been his worry, he would not have come here in the first place.
However, he initially thought it was okay to have no plans since he was with Murakan, but looking back, Murakan was still suffering.
Rather, his condition was worse than before the impostor disappeared.
'As a result of removing the contamination known as the fake... Is Murakan being overwhelmed by more of the memories he was rejecting...?'
Jin returned to Murakan and the Ten Knights. The black tears that Murakan had shed formed a puddle.

Dranax and Biolo were comforting the fallen Frey and trying to hold onto her consciousness. Even though the powers of the Dark Arrival disappeared with the destruction of the fake, there was no way to save Frey. She was already fatally wounded before she was hit by the Dark Arrival.
"Jin... Runcandel..."
Frey looked up at Jin.
"...Yes, ancestor. Bammul is a pseudonym, that's my real name. I had to deceive you as I thought it would confuse you."
"I've felt something was strange... since the beginning. It's just... I wanted to believe. Now that I see, even if we had resisted... you guys would have helped us."
"Frey, don't speak. Concentrate on maintaining consciousness and breathing, we'll soon take you to the healers..."
"Drax, Biolo. We might be... similar to the fake Murakan. Just that the fake one was here to damage something, and we were here to protect. Aren't you all feeling it? My friends..."

Frey was vaguely beginning to understand the truth of the world they had been living in. As the world began to crumble, information they were not supposed to know was flowing into their minds. Drax and Biolo didn't respond, they closed their eyes tightly.
The ten knights realized that their fellow members did not return from external missions, and there were no reinforcements despite the fake one being so rampant.
They realized that this place was a world that reproduced part of the events from a thousand years ago.

"But, Jin Runcandel. Unlike us, you and Murakan are... that foolish black dragon who we thought betrayed us. You're entities that live in reality... Having experienced you, I'm certain that the land we've ultimately protected... is still ours. A thousand years, such a long time has passed..."

"Damn it, why does that black dragon keep acting like that. Hey! Frey, me, Biolo, we all seem to be about to disappear soon. Can't you come to your senses and at least say goodbye? We died a thousand years ago and we won't meet again, you jerk!"
"Yeah, Murakan. Even if we don't know, you shouldn't let Frey go like this. Come and listen to the confession she couldn't make."
"No... Biolo... what kind of nonsense are you saying all of a sudden in this situation..."
The moment Frey flared up, Murakan transformed into a human and stumbled towards Jin and the ten knights.
He fell to the ground, his head touching the earth, and kept repeating the same words like he'd lost his senses.
"I'm sorry... I'm sorry, guys. I killed you... I killed the knights of the family, the people. It was all... my doing..."
Yes, Murakan.
It was all your doing.
At that moment, a low and dark voice came from somewhere.
A voice Jin, Murakan, and the ten knights had all heard before. Jin heard it from the historical records left by Soledad, while the others heard it directly from him.
It was Temar Runcandel.
After brutally killing the colleagues who trusted you... and now you're trying to get rid of me? Is that, the decision of Soledad and you? For the contractor of a thousand years?
Temar's following words became clearer and the landscape was changing.
It was revealing the truth of a thousand years ago, which Ketum had captured before the painting was contaminated. Murakan was looking around with a pale face.
The image of Temar glaring at his past self from a thousand years ago appeared. Murakan couldn't directly look into those resentful eyes.
